sourcesContent:
export const PROJECTS = [
    {
        id: 7,
        title: "AlgoFlow",
        subtitle: "Independent",
        tech: ["Java", "TypeScript", "React", "Spring Boot", "ByteBuddy"],
        desc: "Write Java algorithms and see them execute step by step. Uses a Java agent to transform bytecode at class load time, automatically visualizing arrays, collections, trees, graphs, and method calls with zero manual instrumentation.",
        github: "https://github.com/vish-chan/AlgoFlow",
        link: "https://algopad.up.railway.app/",
    },
    {
        id: 6,
        title: "Configurable Card Table Size for G1 GC",
        subtitle: "OpenJDK",
        tech: ["Java", "JVM", "GC", "C++"],
        desc: "Implemented configurable card table sizing (128B-1024B) for G1, Parallel, and Serial GCs via GCCardSizeInBytes flag, optimizing Remembered Set overhead for large heaps. Improved SpecJBB2015 score by 2%.",
        github: "https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8272773",
    },
    {
        id: 5,
        title: "Backported build-test-lib to JDK 17u",
        subtitle: "OpenJDK",
        tech: ["Java", "JVM", "Testing"],
        desc: "Backported build-test-lib infrastructure to JDK 17u, enabling WhiteBox testing library for jtreg test suite execution.",
        github: "https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8307732",
    },
    {
        id: 4,
        title: "PMU Counter Scaling",
        subtitle: "async-profiler",
        tech: ["C++", "Linux", "Profiling"],
        desc: "Implemented PMU counter scaling for kernel time multiplexing, improving concurrent profiler measurement accuracy.",
        github: "https://github.com/async-profiler/async-profiler",
    },
    {
        id: 3,
        title: "Heapothesys GC Benchmark Fixes",
        subtitle: "Amazon Corretto",
        tech: ["Java", "GC", "Benchmarking"],
        desc: "Fixed survivor queue ordering and integer overflow for allocations ≥1024MB in Amazon Corretto's GC benchmark tool.",
        github: "https://github.com/corretto/heapothesys",
    },
    {
        id: 2,
        title: "MapReduce Job Scheduling in Cloud",
        subtitle: "Masters Thesis",
        tech: ["Java", "CloudSim", "R", "AWS EC2", "Hadoop"],
        desc: "Proposed a deadline-aware scheduling algorithm for MapReduce jobs on EC2, minimizing cost via intelligent Spot instance deployment. Evaluated using Facebook Hadoop job traces.",
        github: "https://github.com/vish-chan/Thesis-Implementation",
    },
    {
        id: 1,
        title: "Roshambo Town",
        subtitle: "Independent",
        tech: ["React", "Redux", "JavaScript"],
        desc: "A Pokemon-style RPG based on rock-paper-scissors with 8 maps and gameboy-style matches.",
        link: "http://vishalchand.com/Roshambo-Town/",
    },
    {
        id: 0,
        title: "CPU Workload Classifier",
        subtitle: "Qualcomm",
        tech: ["Python", "scikit-learn", "Machine Learning"],
        desc: "Boosted decision tree classifier for dynamic CPU workload classification using system-level features from Snapdragon SOC modules.",
    },
]
